title: mpss-centos7-uefi: Reproducible deployment of Intel Xeon Phi (Knights Corner) coprocessors on UEFI CentOS 7
description: A reproducible toolkit and kernel configuration patch that deploys Intel Xeon Phi Knights Corner (KNC) coprocessors with MPSS 3.8.6 on UEFI-based CentOS 7.9 / RHEL 7 hosts, by resolving an undocumented kernel module-signature enforcement deadlock caused by firmware that mis-reports UEFI Secure Boot.
